constraints: Excludes processes whose type is Internal Timer Process (-25), Client Manager Process (-31), or Server Interface Process (-15); counts only 'live' processes (neither aborted nor 'does not exist').

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the number of users currently connected to the 4D Server.

constraints: On a 4D single-user application, always returns 1.

params.name: mergedApp
params.description: Folder containing the built application in which to embed a license.

params.name: autoLicenseTarget
params.description: Target platform for automatic license selection.

sentinelValues.meaning: 4D Volume Desktop -- create a license for a 4D single-user application
4D Server -- create a license for a 4D Server application

overloads.semanticRole: Automatic mode: lets 4D find and embed the most appropriate license for the given autoLicenseTarget platform.

discriminatedBy.rule: Integer (autoLicenseTarget) -- automatic license selection for the named platform target.

overloads.semanticRole: Manual mode: embeds the license(s) explicitly designated by buildLicense (and, if an OEM license is required and not already installed, oemLicense).

discriminatedBy.rule: 4D.File (buildLicense) -- manual designation of the license file(s) to use.

constraints: The generated license file is only valid for the specific application referenced by mergedApp, and must be regenerated whenever that application is rebuilt.
If the Licenses folder does not already exist inside mergedApp, it is created by the command.
In non-automatic mode, if the build requires an OEM license (4D OEM XML Keys) not already installed in the building machine's Licenses folder, it must be supplied via oemLicense.

overloads.semanticRole: Creates (or overwrites) and opens a new document on disk -- or, if document is an empty string, prompts the user via a Save As dialog -- and returns its document reference number.

constraints: If document already exists on disk, it is silently overwritten; if it is locked or already open, an error is generated instead.
Passing an empty string for document displays the standard Save As dialog; if the user cancels, a null DocRef is returned and OK is set to 0.
fileType may list several types separated by ';'; pass "*" or ".*" to not filter/screen file types in the save dialog.
The system variable Document is updated with the created document's full pathname, and OK is set to 1 on success / 0 on failure or cancellation.

overloads.semanticRole: Builds and returns a new alterable entity selection for dsTable's dataclass, from that table's current selection.

constraints: dsTable must be exposed in ds (the datastore); otherwise an error is returned.
Cannot be used with a remote datastore.
The entity selection built preserves the current selection's order (sorted current selection yields an ordered entity selection; unsorted yields an unordered one).

overloads.semanticRole: Creates a new in-memory-only menu (blank, or an exact copy of the menu identified by menu including its submenus) and returns its MenuRef.

constraints: A new MenuRef is created even when copying an existing menu; the copy is independent of the source menu after creation.
A menu created without the menu parameter is blank and must be populated/managed via RELEASE MENU, SET MENU ITEM, and related commands.

params.name: domain
params.description: Filled in with the name of the domain to which the client belongs.

params.name: protocol
params.description: Filled in with the protocol Windows used to authenticate the user: "Kerberos", "NTLM", or empty string if authentication failed.

sentinelValues.meaning: authentication failed / no protocol determined

overloads.semanticRole: Asks the Windows Active Directory server to authenticate the current client via SSO and returns the Windows session login name (empty string on failure), optionally filling in the domain and protocol used.

constraints: Can only be used in the context of an SSO implementation on Windows with 4D Server.
Returns an empty string for the login (and for domain/protocol) if authentication failed.

The security level implied by the result depends on which of domain/protocol come back filled: both filled with Kerberos is the strongest guarantee, filled/empty with NTLM implies a purely local ID, all empty means no authentication info was obtainable.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the current system date, or the server's current date (on 4D Client) if '*' is passed.

constraints: The '*' parameter only has an effect on a 4D Client machine, where it fetches the current date from the server instead of the local client machine.

overloads.semanticRole: Current default table returns a pointer to the table that has been passed to the last call to DEFAULT TABLE for the current process.
The Current form name command returns the name of the current form defined for the process.

constraints: The current form can be a project form or a table form; if FORM LOAD has not been called in the current process, the current form is simply the one being displayed or printed.
If FORM LOAD has been called, the current form remains the one it set until FORM UNLOAD (or CLOSE PRINTING JOB) is called.

Return value depends on how the form was created: the form name, or the filename without extension if created from a .json file, or the object's "name" attribute if created from an object, or an empty string if no current form is defined for the process.

overloads.semanticRole: The Current form table command returns the pointer to the table of the form being displayed or printed in the current process.

constraints: Returns a nil (non-significant) pointer if there is no form being displayed/printed in the current process, or if the current form is a project form (project forms are not attached to a table).
If several windows are open for the current process, the command applies to the form displayed in the active (last-opened) window.

If the current form is the Detail form of a double-clicked subform area, the command returns the pointer to the table shown in the subform area, or a non-significant pointer if the subform area displays a subtable instead of a table.

overloads.semanticRole: The Current form window command returns the reference of the current form window.

constraints: Returns 0 if no window has been set for the current form.
The current form window can be created implicitly by commands such as ADD RECORD, by a user action, or explicitly via Open window / Open form window.

overloads.semanticRole: The Current machine command returns the name of the machine as set in the network parameters of the operating system.
The Current method name command returns the method name where it has been invoked.

constraints: The returned string's format depends on the calling context: 'MethodName' for a database method or project method, 'Trigger on [TableName]' for a trigger, '[TableName].FormName' for a table form method, 'FormName.ObjectName' for a project form object method, 'ClassName:constructor' / 'ClassName.FunctionName' for a class constructor/function, and component-scoped variants like 'MethodName(ComponentName)' when invoked from a component.
Cannot be called from within a 4D formula.
To operate correctly in compiled mode, the calling method must not have range checking disabled (see Range checking).

overloads.semanticRole: The Current method path command returns the internal pathname of the database method, trigger, project method, form method or object method being executed.

constraints: In 4D macro-commands, the <method_path> tag is replaced by this command's return value (the full pathname of the method being executed).

overloads.semanticRole: The Current process name command returns the name of the process within which this command is called.

constraints: Particularly useful with worker processes, to identify the worker process to call when writing generic code (see the About workers section).

overloads.semanticRole: Current process returns the process reference number of the process within which this command is called.
The Current system user command returns the owner name of your machine, as set in the current user account on the machine.

params.description: If passed on a 4D Client machine (4D Server context), returns the current time from the server instead of the local machine's clock.

overloads.semanticRole: The Current time command returns the current time from the system clock.

constraints: The returned time is always between 00:00:00 and 23:59:59.
Use String or Time string to obtain the string form of the returned time expression.

sentinelValues.meaning: 4D user account: always return the 4D user account name (constant '4D user account')
4D user alias: return the alias defined with SET USER ALIAS, or an empty string if none is defined (constant '4D user alias')
4D user alias or account (default if omitted): return the alias if one is defined with SET USER ALIAS, otherwise the regular account name (constant '4D user alias or account')

params.name: toDecrypt
params.description: BLOB to decrypt; overwritten in place with the decrypted data on return.

params.name: sendPubKey
params.description: Sender's public key, generated by the sender with GENERATE ENCRYPTION KEYPAIR.

params.name: recipPrivKey
params.description: Recipient's private key, generated by the recipient with GENERATE ENCRYPTION KEYPAIR.

overloads.semanticRole: Decrypts a BLOB that was encrypted with ENCRYPT BLOB using the sender's public key (and optionally the recipient's private key), returning the decrypted content in-place in the same BLOB.

constraints: Performs a checksum check to detect BLOB content modification; if the encrypted BLOB is damaged or altered, the command does nothing and returns an error.

overloads.semanticRole: Sets aTable as the default table for the current process, so that subsequent commands omitting their table parameter operate on it instead.

constraints: DEFAULT TABLE does not allow omission of the table name when referring to fields directly (e.g. 'My Field:=...' still requires '[My Table]My Field:=...'); it only affects commands that accept an optional table parameter.
DEFAULT TABLE does not open a table, set a current record/selection, or prepare the table for input/output -- it is purely a convenience for omitting table parameters elsewhere.
Takes priority over an identically named default table form when a project form is used with commands such as DIALOG.

params.name: duration
params.description: Delay expressed in ticks (1 tick = 1/60th second); replaces (does not add to) any remaining delay if the process is already delayed.

sentinelValues.meaning: cancel any remaining delay on the process

constraints: If the process does not exist, the command does nothing.
Cannot be used to delay a stored procedure on the server machine from a client machine (process < 0).

overloads.semanticRole: The DELETE DOCUMENT command deletes the document whose name you pass in document .

constraints: document must not be an empty string -- an empty string does not open a file-picker dialog, it generates an error.
If the document is open when deleted: Windows generates an error; macOS deletes it without error.
Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone; DELETE DOCUMENT can delete any file on disk, including files belonging to other applications.

params.name: deleteOption
params.description: Deletion mode; if omitted, behaves as 'Delete only if empty' (0).

sentinelValues.meaning: Delete only if empty: fails with error -47 if the folder is not empty (this is also the default when the parameter is omitted)
Delete with contents: deletes the folder and everything it contains, even if locked/read-only (given sufficient access rights)

constraints: If the folder does not exist: with deleteOption omitted/0, error -120 is generated; with deleteOption=1, the command does nothing and no error is returned.

With deleteOption=1, if any contained file cannot be deleted, deletion aborts as soon as the first inaccessible element is found (error -54 on Windows, -45 on macOS), and the folder may be left only partially deleted; use Last errors to find the offending file.
Errors can be intercepted with a method installed via ON ERR CALL.

params.name: array
params.description: Array to shrink; mutated in place.

params.name: howMany
params.description: Number of consecutive elements to delete starting at where; the array shrinks by this amount. If omitted, exactly 1 element is deleted.

params.name: blob
params.description: BLOB to shrink in place; becomes len bytes smaller.

constraints: Because it alters the BLOB parameter in place, this command does not support 4D.Blob objects, only legacy BLOB variables/fields (see Passing blobs and blob objects to 4D commands).

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, 'list' below is an object name (Text); if omitted, 'list' is a hierarchical list reference number (Integer). Required if several representations of the same list exist and you are targeting the current item (second '*' passed), since only object-name addressing distinguishes each representation's own current item.

params.name: itemRef

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to the list
the currently selected list item

params.description: If no item exists with the given reference number, the command does nothing.

params.name: eraseSublist
params.description: If passed, any sublist attached to the deleted item is also erased from memory. If omitted, the sublist (if any) is not erased -- retrieve its list reference number beforehand (e.g. to delete it later with CLEAR LIST) if needed.

overloads.semanticRole: Deletes a single item (or, if the trailing * is passed, its attached sublist too) from a hierarchical list, identified by item reference number, by the sentinel 0 (last item added), or by the sentinel * (currently selected item).

interactionNotes.note: The literal symbol '*' means two unrelated things depending on position: leading = 'list is a name, not a ref number'; in itemRef's slot = 'operate on the current item'.

overloads.semanticRole: Deletes every index (keyword or standard) built on the field referenced by fieldPtr, but leaves any composite index containing that field untouched.

discriminatedBy.rule: Same declared type (Pointer, Text) as overload 2's indexName; which one applies depends on whether the value/pointer designates a field or an index name, not on its static type.

overloads.semanticRole: Deletes only the single, specifically named index (keyword, standard, or composite) referenced by indexName.

discriminatedBy.rule: Same declared type (Pointer, Text) as overload 1's fieldPtr; which one applies depends on whether the value/pointer designates a field or an index name, not on its static type.

constraints: Overloads 1 and 2 declare the identical parameter type (Pointer, Text). Which one applies depends on what the pointer/name actually references at runtime -- not checkable from the call site alone.
If there is no index corresponding to fieldPtr or indexName, the command does nothing.
The trailing optional '*' performs the deindexing asynchronously: the calling method continues execution immediately regardless of whether the index deletion has finished.

params.name: menu
params.description: Menu number, or a MenuRef (reference) created with Create menu.

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to menu

params.name: process
params.description: If omitted, applies to the menu bar of the current process. Ignored if menu is a MenuRef.

constraints: If the designated menu item is itself a menu managed by reference (e.g. created with Create menu), only that instance in menu is removed; the referenced submenu itself continues to exist in memory until explicitly released with RELEASE MENU.
Also works with a menu bar created with Create menu and installed with SET MENU BAR.

overloads.semanticRole: DELETE RECORD deletes the current record of aTable in the process.

constraints: Has no effect if there is no current record for aTable in the process (including if the record was unloaded before the call, e.g. via UNLOAD RECORD).
Does nothing when the table is in READ ONLY mode, regardless of whether the record to be deleted is locked.
Permanent and cannot be undone outside of a transaction (see Using Transactions).
Deleted record numbers are reused by subsequently created records -- do not use the record number as a durable record identifier if records may ever be deleted.

overloads.semanticRole: DELETE SELECTION deletes the current selection of records from aTable .

constraints: Has no effect if the current selection of aTable is empty; after deletion the current selection becomes empty.
Permanent and cannot be undone.
Records deleted during a transaction are locked to other users/processes until the transaction is validated or canceled.
Unchecking 'Records definitively deleted' for the table (in the Inspector) speeds up deletions performed by this command.

overloads.semanticRole: The DELETE USER command deletes the user whose unique user ID number you pass in userID .

constraints: Only the Designer and Administrator can delete users; the Administrator cannot delete a user created by the Designer.
userID must be a valid user ID number as returned by GET USER LIST; if the account does not exist or was already deleted, error -9979 is generated (catchable via a method installed with ON ERR CALL).
Deleted user names no longer appear in the Users editor (opened via EDIT ACCESS) nor in Design mode; their numbers may be reassigned to new user accounts later.

sentinelValues.meaning: enable internal query analysis mode for the current process (records the query plan and query path for each subsequent 4D-language query)
disable internal query analysis mode

constraints: Only affects queries made through 4D language query commands such as QUERY.

Recorded query plan/path can be read via the Last query plan and Last query path commands; they usually match but can differ when 4D dynamically re-optimizes a query (e.g. converting an indexed query to sequential).
Enabling query analysis mode can slow down the application.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table owning the form. If omitted, the default table is used, or a project form is expected.

params.name: form
params.description: Name of a table/project form, a POSIX path to a .json file describing the form, or an object describing the form.

params.name: formData
params.description: Object whose properties become available inside the form via the Form command. Takes priority over an associated form class: if formData is passed (and defined), the form class object is not instantiated. If omitted (or undefined) and no form class is associated, DIALOG creates a new empty object bound to the form.

params.name: useCurrentProcess
params.description: If passed, the form loads and displays in the last-open window of the current process; DIALOG returns immediately while the form remains active on screen, reacting normally to user actions until CANCEL/ACCEPT (or a standard action) closes it, or the process terminates.

overloads.semanticRole: Presents a form (project/table form name, a .json path, or a form-description object) to the user, either modally (blocking until an accept/cancel action), or -- if the trailing '*' is passed -- non-modally in the last-opened window of the current process while execution continues immediately.

constraints: A dialog is closed by an 'accept' action (ak accept, Enter, or ACCEPT) which sets OK to 1, or a 'cancel' action (ak cancel, Escape, or CANCEL) which sets OK to 0.
Validation is not saving: if the form includes fields, SAVE RECORD must be called explicitly to persist modified data.

When the trailing '*' is used, a window must already exist (created beforehand) -- the current dialog window or the default per-process window cannot be reused, otherwise error -9909 is generated. The window is closed automatically by 4D once the form is dismissed.

overloads.semanticRole: DIFFERENCE compares set1 and set2 and excludes all records that are in set2 from the resultSet .

constraints: set1 and set2 must be sets on the same table; resultSet belongs to that same table.
resultSet replaces any existing set with the same name, including if that name is set1 or set2 itself.
In Client/Server mode, all three sets must be visible on the same machine (visibility depends on set type -- interprocess/process/local -- and where each set was created, server or client).

params.name: menu
params.description: Menu number, or a MenuRef (reference) created with Create menu.

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to the menu
all items of the menu at once (enable/disable in bulk)

params.name: process
params.description: If omitted, applies to the menu bar of the current process. Ignored if menu is a MenuRef.

constraints: If menuItem designates a hierarchical submenu, all items of that submenu (and any of its own submenus) are disabled too.
Also works with a menu bar created with Create menu and installed with SET MENU BAR.

overloads.semanticRole: The DISPLAY NOTIFICATION command displays a notification message to the user.

constraints: title and text are each limited to 255 characters.
Under macOS (10.8+), the notification is only shown while the application is not in the foreground, though it still appears in Notification Center regardless.
Under Windows, the notification remains displayed until machine activity is detected or the user clicks its close box; duration overrides this default display behavior.
Actual display of notifications also depends on the OS/system notification configuration.

overloads.semanticRole: Displays the current record of aTable in its current input form, e.g. for custom progress messages or a free-running slide show.

constraints: Does nothing if there is no current record.
The record is displayed only until an event redraws the window (e.g. ADD RECORD, returning to an input form, or returning to the menu bar).
Must not be called from within a Web connection process: it would execute on the 4D Web server machine, not the Web browser client machine.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table to display, or Default table, if omitted

params.name: selectMode
params.description: Selection mode: pass one of the 'Form Parameters' theme constants (No selection=0, Single selection=1, Multiple selection=2); defaults to Multiple selection

params.name: enterList
params.description: True to authorize the 'Enter in list' mode (selection of values in the list, not modification); defaults to False

params.name: useOutputFormForOneRecord
params.description: If present, a one-record selection is displayed using the output form (instead of the input form), and scroll bars are hidden if the user double-clicks into the input form

params.name: showScrollBars
params.description: If present, reverses the scroll-bar-hiding effect of the first optional '*', showing scroll bars in the input form again

overloads.semanticRole: Displays the selection of aTable as a scrollable list using the output form, letting the user select (and optionally enter-in-list edit) records.

jointConstraints.rule: showScrollBars only has an effect when useOutputFormForOneRecord is also passed; it overrides that flag's scroll-bar-hiding behavior.

constraints: If enterList is omitted, Enter-in-list mode is disabled by default; if selectMode is omitted, Multiple Selection mode is used by default.
During and after execution, records the user highlights are kept in a set named UserSet, available to object methods and to the calling method after DISPLAY SELECTION completes.

params.name: objectField
params.description: Indexed object field; must be an indexed Object-type field or an error is returned

params.name: pathArray
params.description: Receives the distinct attribute paths (dot notation), in alphabetical (diacritic) order

overloads.semanticRole: Returns, in alphabetical order, the list of distinct object attribute paths found in an indexed Object field for the current selection.

constraints: objectField must be an indexed Object-type field; otherwise an error is returned.
Records with an undefined value in objectField are not taken into account.
Does not change the current selection or the current record.

params.name: objectField
params.description: Object field to get distinct attribute values from; must be of the Object type

params.name: path
params.description: Dot-notation path of the attribute whose distinct values to get (case-sensitive)

params.name: valuesArray
params.description: Receives the non-repeated values; must be the same scalar array type (Text, number, Boolean, Date, or Time) as the values stored at path -- confirmed a real array (not a pseudo/any placeholder) by the doc syntax line 'valuesArray : Array' and its example ('ARRAY LONGINT(aLAges;0)' declared before the call).

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the non-repeated (unique) values found at a given nested attribute path of an Object field, for the current selection.

constraints: objectField must be of the Object type, otherwise an error is returned.

All values at path across the selection must be of the same scalar type (Text, number, Boolean, Date, or Time); mixed types (e.g. text in one record, number in another) generate an error. Pointers, objects, BLOBs, and images are not supported.
Can be used with indexed or non-indexed fields, but is slower on unindexed fields and loses the current record in that case.
Does not change the current selection or the current record.

params.name: aField
params.description: Indexable field to use for data; unindexed fields are supported but slower

params.name: array
params.description: Receives the distinct field values, sorted ascending using the field's index; must match aField's type (retyped if necessary, except Picture fields with a keyword index, which require a Text array) -- confirmed a real array (not a pseudo/any placeholder) by the doc syntax line 'array : Array'.

params.name: countArray
params.description: Receives, for each value in array, its number of occurrences in the current selection; not supported (returned empty) for text/picture fields with a keyword index

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the non-repeated (unique) values of a field for the current selection, sorted ascending via the field's index, and optionally the occurrence count of each value.

constraints: Does not support Object type fields.
For Text fields, a keyword index (if any) is always used in preference to a standard index; for Picture fields, a keyword index is required or the array is returned empty.
Executing on an unindexed field is slower and loses the current record.
On 4D Server, the array is built and values calculated server-side, then the whole array is sent to the client.
Does not change the current selection or the current record.

params.name: pathname
params.description: Absolute pathname to volume, directory, or folder

params.name: documents
params.description: Receives the names (or paths, depending on options) of documents found; empty array if none found

params.name: options
params.description: Bit-combinable constants from the System Documents theme: Recursive parsing=1, Absolute path=2, Posix path=4, Ignore invisible=8; defaults to plain document names only when omitted

overloads.semanticRole: Populates an array with the names (or paths) of documents present at a given folder/volume location, with options controlling path format and recursion.

constraints: In relative mode with Recursive parsing (option 1 only), subfolder document paths begin with ':' (macOS) or '\' (Windows).
In relative mode with Posix path (option 4 only), paths do not start with '/'; in absolute mode with Posix path (option 4 + 2), paths always begin with '/'.
An invalid pathname generates a file manager error, interceptable via ON ERR CALL.

params.name: document
params.description: Name of an existing document that is not already open

params.name: blob
params.description: BLOB field or variable that receives the document contents

overloads.semanticRole: Loads the entire contents of an existing, unopened document into a BLOB.

constraints: document must name an existing document that is not already open, otherwise an error is generated.
To let the user choose the document interactively, use Open document with its process variable Document instead of a literal name.

overloads.semanticRole: Appends a new child node (comment, processing instruction, CDATA, DATA, DOCTYPE, or ELEMENT) with the given value to an XML node, returning a reference to the new child. The node kind is selected by the childType constant (one of the 'XML' theme values: comment=2, processing instruction=3, DATA=6, CDATA=7, DOCTYPE=10, ELEMENT=11).

constraints: childValue's contents are always converted to text before insertion.

If elementRef designates the Document node (top level), a Doctype node is inserted before any other node; processing instructions and comments are always inserted before the root node (but after any Doctype node).
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Appends an existing XML element as the last child of another XML element's children.

constraints: Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Frees the memory occupied by an XML tree, ending its DOM lifecycle.

constraints: elementRef must be an XML root object (e.g. as returned by DOM Create XML Ref or DOM Parse XML source/variable); otherwise an error is generated.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the number of XML attributes present on a given XML element.
Returns the number of direct child elements of elementRef that are named elementName.

constraints: elementName matching is case-sensitive by default (XML compliance); case sensitivity can be changed via the 'XML DOM case sensitivity' selector of XML SET OPTIONS.

overloads.semanticRole: Creates a new, empty in-memory XML tree with the given root element name (and optional namespace declarations), returning its root reference.

jointConstraints.rule: If root is prefixed with 'namespaceName:', nameSpace (declaring that namespace's value) must also be passed.

constraints: You must call DOM CLOSE XML on the returned reference when finished, to free the in-memory XML tree.
root may be prefixed with a namespace name followed by ':' (e.g. "MyNameSpace:MyRoot"); when it is, the nameSpace parameter (the namespace value) becomes mandatory.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Creates a new XML element at a given XPath location under elementRef, setting attributes from parallel name/value arrays, and returns its reference.

constraints: Identical to DOM Create XML element except that attribute names/values are passed as parallel arrays (already created and sized beforehand) instead of scalar pairs; you can pass as many array pairs, and as many elements per pair, as needed.
attribValuesArray may be of Text, Date, number, or Picture type; 4D converts values to text automatically (configurable via XML SET OPTIONS).
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Creates a new XML element at a given XPath location under elementRef, optionally setting attribute name/value pairs on it, and returns its reference.

constraints: xPath uses a subset of XPath notation (absolute/relative paths, indexed predicates like para[1]/para[last()]); if any intermediate path elements don't exist, they are created, otherwise a new node is added.
If the tree (elementRef) has one or more namespaces defined, xPath must be prefixed with the namespace to use (e.g. "MyNameSpace:MyElement").
Non-text attrValue values (Boolean, Integer, Real, Date, Time) are automatically converted to their text representation.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

params.name: elementRef
params.description: Root XML element reference to export

params.name: filePath
params.description: Full access path of the file to create/overwrite; if only a file name is given (no path), the file is searched for, or created, next to the structure file

sentinelValues.meaning: displays a standard save/open file dialog box for the user to choose the destination

overloads.semanticRole: Saves an XML tree to a file on disk, creating the file if it doesn't already exist.

constraints: On export, internal LF line breaks are replaced by CRLF on Windows (no replacement on macOS); use an XML CDATA element (or the "" entity) to preserve literal carriage returns.
Files are written without a BOM by default; line-ending and BOM behavior are controlled via XML SET OPTIONS (compatibility note: pre-v19.x databases default to CR line endings on macOS and a BOM).
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

params.name: elementRef
params.description: Root XML element reference to export

params.name: vXmlVar
params.description: Text or BLOB variable that receives the exported XML tree

overloads.semanticRole: Saves an XML tree into a Text or BLOB variable in memory.

constraints: vXmlVar must be a Text or BLOB variable; a Text variable is limited to 32K in non-Unicode mode (2GB in Unicode mode), and in non-Unicode mode its content loses its original encoding declaration (use BLOB to preserve valid, sendable XML in that case).
On export, internal LF line breaks are replaced by CRLF on Windows (no replacement on macOS); use an XML CDATA element (or the "" entity) to preserve literal carriage returns.
Written without a BOM by default; line-ending and BOM behavior are controlled via XML SET OPTIONS.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

commands.displayName: DOM Find XML element by ID

overloads.semanticRole: Searches the whole XML document (regardless of elementRef's position) for the element whose id attribute equals a given value.

constraints: The document's id attribute values must each be unique and a valid XML name (XML validity constraint); if this is violated, the command's result is unpredictable (it returns the reference to the first matching element found).
The search always covers the whole document, regardless of which element elementRef designates.

params.name: elementRef
params.description: XML element reference at which the search starts

params.name: xPath
params.description: XPath expression identifying the element(s) to look for

params.name: arrElementRefs
params.description: Receives the list of all matching element references, useful when several elements match xPath

overloads.semanticRole: Searches an XML structure, starting at elementRef, for element(s) matching an XPath expression, returning the (first) match's reference and optionally all matches.

constraints: Searches are case sensitive.
When arrElementRefs is passed and filled, the command's function-result return value is the first element of that array.

commands.displayName: DOM GET XML ATTRIBUTE BY INDEX

params.name: elementRef
params.description: XML element reference

params.name: attribIndex
params.description: Index of the attribute (alphabetical position among the element's attributes), 1-based

params.name: attribName
params.description: Receives the attribute's name

params.name: attribValue
params.description: Receives the attribute's value, converted to the variable's declared type

silentCoercionDefault.condition: If attribValue's variable type is not defined, the value is returned as Text by default.

overloads.semanticRole: Gets the name and value of an XML element's attribute selected by its (alphabetical) index position.

constraints: The attribute index order is not the file's textual order: in XML, attribute index reflects alphabetical order of attribute names.
An attribIndex greater than the element's attribute count generates an error.

commands.displayName: DOM GET XML ATTRIBUTE BY NAME

params.name: elementRef
params.description: XML element reference

params.name: attribName
params.description: Name of the attribute to get the value of

params.name: attribValue
params.description: Receives the attribute's value, converted to the variable's declared type

silentCoercionDefault.condition: If attribValue's variable type is not defined, the value is returned as Text by default.

overloads.semanticRole: Gets the value of an XML element's attribute selected by name.

constraints: If no attribute named attribName exists, an error is returned.
If several attributes share the same name, only the first one's value is returned.

params.name: elementRef
params.description: XML element reference

params.name: childTypesArr
params.description: Receives the type of each child node: one of the 'XML' theme constants (comment=2, processing instruction=3, DATA=6, CDATA=7, DOCTYPE=10, ELEMENT=11)

params.name: nodeRefsArr
params.description: Receives, for each child node, its reference (for ELEMENT nodes) or its value (for content/instruction nodes)

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the types and references/values of all direct child nodes of an XML element.

params.name: elementRef
params.description: XML element reference

params.name: elementName
params.description: Receives the name of the XML element

silentCoercionDefault.condition: If elementName's variable type is not defined, Text is used by default.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the name of an XML element.

params.name: elementRef
params.description: XML element reference

params.name: elementValue
params.description: Receives the value of the XML element

silentCoercionDefault.condition: If elementValue's variable type is not defined, Text is used by default.

params.name: cDATA
params.description: Receives the contents of the CDATA section(s) of the element

silentCoercionDefault.condition: If cDATA's variable type is not defined, Text is used by default.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the value of an XML element and, optionally, the contents of its CDATA section(s).

constraints: If the element was a BLOB set via DOM SET XML ELEMENT VALUE, its value was automatically base64-encoded; this command automatically attempts to base64-decode it back.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the reference of the DOM tree's document node (the parent of the root element), given the reference of any element in the tree.

constraints: Only usable together with DOM Append XML child node and DOM GET XML CHILD NODES; at this document-node level you can only append/replace Doctype, processing-instruction, or comment nodes (not CDATA or Text nodes).

params.name: elementRef
params.description: XML element reference

params.name: elementName
params.description: Name of the child element to get

params.name: index
params.description: Index number (among same-named children) of the element to get

params.name: elementValue
params.description: Receives the value of the found element

params.name: attrNames
params.description: Receives the names of the found element's attributes

params.name: attrValues
params.description: Receives the values of the found element's attributes

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the reference of a child element identified by name and index, optionally along with its value and attribute name/value arrays.

constraints: elementName matching is case-sensitive by default (XML compliance); configurable via the 'XML DOM case sensitivity' selector of XML SET OPTIONS.
attrNames/attrValues arrays are automatically created and sized by the command if passed.

overloads.semanticRole: Retrieves document-level XML info (encoding, XML version, DOCTYPE name/public ID/system ID, or DTD document URI) selected by an xmlInfo constant.

commands.displayName: DOM Get first child XML element

params.name: elementRef
params.description: XML element reference

params.name: childElemName
params.description: Receives the name of the first child element

params.name: childElemValue
params.description: Receives the value of the first child element

overloads.semanticRole: Returns a reference to the first child of an XML element, usable for further DOM navigation, and optionally its name and value.

jointConstraints.rule: childElemValue can only be passed if childElemName is also passed (the syntax nests childElemValue inside childElemName's optional group).

commands.displayName: DOM Get last child XML element

params.name: elementRef
params.description: XML element reference

params.name: childElemName
params.description: Receives the name of the last child element

params.name: childElemValue
params.description: Receives the value of the last child element

overloads.semanticRole: Returns a reference to the last child of an XML element, usable for further DOM navigation, and optionally its name and value.

jointConstraints.rule: childElemValue can only be passed if childElemName is also passed (the syntax nests childElemValue inside childElemName's optional group).

commands.displayName: DOM Get next sibling XML element

params.name: elementRef
params.description: XML element reference

params.name: siblingElemName
params.description: Receives the name of the next sibling element

params.name: siblingElemValue
params.description: Receives the value of the next sibling element

overloads.semanticRole: Navigates to the next sibling of an XML element, returning its reference and optionally its name and value; sets OK to 0 after the last sibling.

jointConstraints.rule: siblingElemValue can only be passed if siblingElemName is also passed (the syntax nests siblingElemValue inside siblingElemName's optional group).

constraints: After the last sibling is reached, the system variable OK is set to 0.

params.name: elementRef
params.description: XML element reference

params.name: parentElemName
params.description: Receives the name of the parent element

params.name: parentElemValue
params.description: Receives the value of the parent element

overloads.semanticRole: Returns a reference to the parent XML element (or the "#document" reference if elementRef is a root element), optionally filling in the parent's name and value.

constraints: If elementRef is already the document node, the command returns a null reference ("0000000000000000") and sets OK to 0.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

commands.displayName: DOM Get previous sibling XML element

params.name: elementRef
params.description: XML element reference

params.name: siblingElemName
params.description: Receives the name of the previous sibling element

params.name: siblingElemValue
params.description: Receives the value of the previous sibling element

overloads.semanticRole: Returns a reference to the previous sibling of elementRef among its parent's children, for use navigating the children of an XML element; sets OK to 0 before the first sibling.

constraints: Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Returns a reference to the root element of the document that the XML element passed in elementRef belongs to (or "" on error).

constraints: Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Inserts an existing XML element (sourceElementRef, from the same DOM tree) as a child of targetElementRef, before the child at position childIndex, and returns a reference to the inserted element.

constraints: sourceElementRef must already be the reference of an existing XML element in a DOM tree, not newly-authored text.
If childIndex does not designate a valid existing child of targetElementRef, the new element is inserted before the first child.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Parses an XML document from a path/URL, optionally validating it against a DTD (either referenced inside the document or explicitly designated by the dtd parameter), and returns a document reference.

discriminatedBy.rule: Third parameter is a DTD pathname/text (or omitted to use any DTD/XSD reference found inside the document itself).

overloads.semanticRole: Parses an XML document from a path/URL, optionally validating it against an XML Schema (XSD) explicitly designated by the schema parameter.

discriminatedBy.rule: Third parameter is an XSD file/URL pathname, selected instead of the dtd overload to validate by schema rather than DTD.

constraints: Execution of DOM Parse XML source is synchronous.
document can be a full pathname, a Unix-style macOS path, an http(s)/ftp URL, or an empty string to prompt an Open File dialog.

If validation is True and the third parameter is omitted, validation is attempted via a DTD or XSD reference found inside the document itself; this can chain (a referenced DTD that itself references an XSD).
If validation cannot be performed (no DTD/XSD found, bad URL, etc.), an error is generated and reported via the Error system variable.
The returned reference must eventually be released by calling DOM CLOSE XML with it.

The dtd/schema overloads are not statically distinguishable by parameter type (both Text) -- 4D discriminates at runtime by file-extension convention (a ".dtd" path selects DTD validation, an ".xsd" path selects schema validation) or by content-sniffing (if the third parameter's text begins with "<?xml", it is treated as an inline DTD rather than a pathname).
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Parses an XML structure held in a BLOB or Text variable, optionally validating it against a DTD (either referenced inside the structure or explicitly designated by the dtd parameter), and returns a document reference.

discriminatedBy.rule: Third parameter is a DTD pathname/text (or omitted to use any DTD/XSD reference found inside the structure itself).

overloads.semanticRole: Parses an XML structure held in a BLOB or Text variable, optionally validating it against an XML Schema (XSD) explicitly designated by the schema parameter.

discriminatedBy.rule: Third parameter is an XSD file/URL pathname, selected instead of the dtd overload to validate by schema rather than DTD.

constraints: variable holds the raw XML structure itself (a BLOB or Text value), not a pathname.

If validation is True and the third parameter is omitted, validation is attempted via a DTD or XSD reference found inside the structure itself; this can chain (a referenced DTD that itself references an XSD).
If validation cannot be performed, an error is generated and reported via the Error system variable.
The returned reference must eventually be released by calling DOM CLOSE XML with it.

The dtd/schema overloads are not statically distinguishable by parameter type (both Text) -- 4D discriminates at runtime by file-extension convention (a ".dtd" path selects DTD validation, an ".xsd" path selects schema validation) or by content-sniffing, same as DOM Parse XML source.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Removes the attribute named attribName from the XML element elementRef, if it exists.

constraints: Sets the OK system variable to 1 on success, or 0 (with an error) if attribName does not exist on elementRef.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Removes the XML element designated by elementRef (and its subtree) from the DOM.

constraints: Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Sets (adding if not present) one or more attribute name/value pairs on the XML element elementRef, converting non-Text attrValue values to text.

constraints: attrValue may be Text or another scalar type (Boolean, Integer, Real, Date, Time); non-Text values are converted to text (e.g. Boolean -> "true"/"false", Date -> RFC 3339 string, Time -> number of seconds as text).
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Sets declaration options (character-set encoding and whether the tree is standalone) for the XML tree rooted at elementRef.

constraints: encoding defaults to UTF-8 if the command is not called, or if an unsupported character set is passed.
standalone defaults to False (not standalone) if omitted or if the command is not called.
indentation is kept only for compatibility with pre-v12 databases; it is not recommended, and XML SET OPTIONS should be used instead to control document indentation.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Renames the XML element elementRef to elementName, updating its open and close tags.

constraints: Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Modifies the value of the element designated by elementRef (or by an XPath expression relative to it, if xPath is passed), optionally writing the value as CDATA when the trailing '*' is passed.

constraints: If elementValue is undefined, an empty string is used.
If elementRef designates a BLOB, the value is automatically base64-encoded (and DOM GET XML ELEMENT VALUE automatically decodes it back).
All CR and CRLF end-of-line characters in elementValue are replaced by LF to comply with XML processing rules.
Arrays, pictures, and pointers cannot be passed as elementValue.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloads.semanticRole: Lets the user drag the frontmost window under the mouse, tracking mouse movement until the button is released; typically called from an invisible button's object method on mouse-down.
Disconnects the remote user identified by the userSession session ID from 4D Server.

constraints: Runs asynchronously and only has effect when executed on 4D Server; does nothing when called locally on a remote client or in 4D single-user.
The userSession ID can be retrieved with the Process activity command.

overloads.semanticRole: Creates a new record for aTable (or the default table, if omitted) that duplicates the current record, and makes the duplicate the current record; does nothing if there is no current record.

constraints: The duplicate is not saved until SAVE RECORD is called.
No longer supports subtables as of 4D v11.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns an object describing the encryption status (overall and per-table) of the data file designated by structurePath/dataPath.

jointConstraints.rule: Both parameters are wrapped together as one optional group in the doc syntax, implying they must be supplied as a pair (a specific, non-open structure/data file combination) rather than independently.

constraints: dataPath must correspond to the structure file given by structurePath, and must not be the currently-open data file.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the full pathname of the current database's data file.

constraints: segment is obsolete (ignored) since 4D v11, when data segments were removed; it must no longer be used.
When called from 4D in remote mode, only the file name is returned, not the full pathname.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns an object with detailed 4D database engine measures (disk/cache read-write access, index/query/sort usage), optionally scoped or filtered by the options object.
Evaluates expression (a string in ISO date format or the system's regional short-date format, or an existing Date value) and returns the corresponding Date.
Returns the weekday number (1-7, Sunday=1) of aDate; returns 2 for null dates.
Returns the day-of-month number (1-31) of date.
Returns True in a form/object method when the frontmost window containing the form has just moved to the background (equivalent to detecting the On Deactivate form event).

constraints: Requires the On Deactivate form/object event property to be enabled in the Design environment for the execution cycle to fire.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the decimal (fractional) portion of number, always as a non-negative value.

params.name: blobToDecrypt
params.description: BLOB to decrypt

params.name: keyObject
params.description: JSON object containing the encryption key, with the same structure as the object returned by New data key

params.name: salt
params.description: Salt value; must match the one used for encryption

params.name: decryptedBLOB
params.description: Receives the decrypted data (empty on error)

overloads.semanticRole: Decrypts blobToDecrypt (AES-256) using an explicit encryption-key object, returning the result in decryptedBLOB and True on success.

discriminatedBy.rule: Second parameter is an Object holding a prebuilt encryption key (as returned by New data key).

params.name: blobToDecrypt
params.description: BLOB to decrypt

params.name: passPhrase
params.description: Passphrase used to generate the encryption key directly

params.name: salt
params.description: Salt value; must match the one used for encryption

params.name: decryptedBLOB
params.description: Receives the decrypted data (empty on error)

overloads.semanticRole: Decrypts blobToDecrypt (AES-256) using a passphrase to derive the encryption key directly, returning the result in decryptedBLOB and True on success.

discriminatedBy.rule: Second parameter is a Text passphrase used to generate the key directly.

constraints: salt must match the value used when the BLOB was originally encrypted, or decryption fails.

overloads.semanticRole: Removes numChars characters from source starting at position where, and returns the resulting string.

constraints: If where is less than 1, deletion starts from the beginning of source.
If where + numChars is >= the length of source, characters are deleted through the end of source.
Returns source unchanged if source is empty, where exceeds the length of source, or numChars is 0.

overloads.semanticRole: Searches the root level of all connected devices for a ".4DKeyChain" file holding a valid encryption key for the currently-open data file; if found, applies it and adds it to the 4D keychain, returning True.

constraints: Only searches the top level of connected devices (USB keys, external disks); does not traverse folder hierarchies.
Key files must use the ".4DKeyChain" extension and store the key in JSON format.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the 1-based row number currently being processed while a list of records or list box row is displayed, valid only inside an On Display Detail form event; returns 0 otherwise.

constraints: For a list of records, when the displayed row is linked to a record its value matches Selected record number; unlike Selected record number, it also reports empty rows.

overloads.semanticRole: Reads the contents of the disk file fileName into a text result, applying character-set decoding and end-of-line normalization.

constraints: fileName can be a bare file name (resolved next to the structure file), a pathname relative to the structure file, or an absolute pathname; the file must exist or an error is generated (caught via ON ERR CALL).
If the document has a Byte Order Mark (BOM), the BOM's character set is used instead of charSet, which is then ignored.
If there is no BOM and charSet is omitted, the default is ANSI on Windows and MacRoman on macOS.
breakMode defaults to native line-break format (1) when omitted; other values (0=unchanged, 2=CRLF, 3=CR, 4=LF) are documented constants in the System Documents theme.
Does not modify the OK system variable; failures raise a catchable error instead.

params.name: columnNumber
params.description: Receives the list box column number where the drop occurred (-1 if beyond the last column)

overloads.semanticRole: Called while handling a drag-and-drop event over a list box: returns the row number where the item was dropped, and fills in columnNumber with the column.

discriminatedBy.rule: Not selected by parameter type (both overloads take one optional Integer out-parameter); the applicable overload depends on the destination form object's type (list box vs picture) at the time of the drop event, which is not statically knowable from the call site.

params.name: pictPosY
params.description: Receives the vertical (Y) pixel coordinate of the drop, local to the picture object

overloads.semanticRole: Called while handling a drag-and-drop event over a picture-type variable/field: returns the X pixel coordinate of the drop, and fills in pictPosY with the Y coordinate.

discriminatedBy.rule: Not selected by parameter type; the applicable overload depends on the destination form object's type (picture vs list box) at the time of the drop event, which is not statically knowable from the call site.

constraints: Over a hierarchical list, the function result is an item position; over a text/combo box/4D Write Pro area, it is a character position within the string; in these cases there is no out-parameter.
Returns -1 if the source was dropped beyond the last element/item of the destination, or if called outside a drag-and-drop event over a droppable object.
Only applies to a form object whose Droppable property is selected.

overloads.semanticRole: Displays the hierarchical pop-up menu referenced by menu (created via Create menu) at the mouse location or at (xCoord, yCoord) if given, optionally pre-selecting the item associated with the default parameter, and returns the parameter string of the item chosen.

jointConstraints.rule: xCoord and yCoord must be passed together; if only one is passed it is effectively ignored and the menu is shown at the mouse location.

constraints: menu must be a reference returned by Create menu, not a plain text menu (use Pop up menu for text-based pop-up menus).
default identifies an item by the custom string previously assigned via SET MENU ITEM PARAMETER; only a top-level item can be selected by default. If omitted, the first item is selected by default.
Should generally be called in response to a right mouse click or a mouse-down-and-hold, per standard context-menu interface conventions.

overloads.semanticRole: Opens the Toolbox window's Users and User groups pages so the current user can interactively edit the password/access system.

constraints: This command opens a modal window; do not call it from another modal window, otherwise it does nothing.
Has no effect if no groups are defined.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table to display by default in the Formula editor

params.name: formula
params.description: in: variable containing the formula to display, or "" to display the editor with no formula; out: the formula validated by the user (left untouched if the user cancels)

overloads.semanticRole: Displays the interactive Formula editor dialog, seeded with aTable's fields and an initial formula, and returns the user-edited formula text.

constraints: By default, method/command access is restricted to the Designer and Administrator; if formula calls a method not authorized via SET ALLOWED METHODS, a syntax error is generated and the dialog cannot be validated.
The formula editor has no default menu bar; install a standard Edit menu in the calling process to enable cut/copy/paste shortcuts.
The virtual structure defined by SET TABLE TITLES/SET FIELD TITLES is only used inside the Formula editor dialog; it must not be used in the formula variable outside the dialog.
Validating the dialog only stores the edited formula text into the formula variable; it does not execute it -- use EXECUTE FORMULA to run it.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, 'object' below is an object name (pass a string); if omitted, 'object' is a Table or Variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if '*' passed) or Table/variable reference (if '*' omitted)

params.name: item
params.description: Position of the item (hierarchical list) or row number (list box column/list form/subform); if omitted, applies to the current item, or the first item if there is no current item.

overloads.semanticRole: Switches the current (or specified) item of the given enterable list-like object into edit mode, replacing its content on the next keystroke.

constraints: Applies only to enterable objects: hierarchical lists, list box columns, subforms (object name only), and list forms displayed via DISPLAY SELECTION/MODIFY SELECTION.
If used on an enterable object that is not a list, it behaves the same as GOTO OBJECT.
Does nothing if the target list/array is empty or invisible; if the list/array is not enterable, it only selects the item without entering edit mode.

params.name: menu
params.description: Menu number or MenuRef

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to the menu
all items of the menu at once

params.name: process
params.description: Process reference number; if omitted, applies to the menu bar of the current process

overloads.semanticRole: Enables (makes selectable) the specified menu item, or all items of a submenu/menu, in a given process's menu bar.

constraints: If menu is passed as a MenuRef, the process parameter is ignored.

params.name: toEncrypt
params.description: in: data to encrypt; out: the encrypted data (overwrites the input BLOB)

params.name: sendPrivKey
params.description: Sender's private key

params.name: recipPubKey
params.description: Recipient's public key

overloads.semanticRole: Encrypts a BLOB's content in place using the sender's private key (and optionally the recipient's public key), overwriting it with the encrypted data.

constraints: sendPrivKey and recipPubKey should be generated by the GENERATE ENCRYPTION KEYPAIR command (Secured Protocol theme); the keys use a cross-platform PKCS format.
Uses the TLS protocol algorithm/features; the TLS protocol components must be installed on the machine even if TLS is not otherwise used for server connections.

Data encrypted with only the sender's private key can be decrypted by anyone holding the matching public key; passing both sendPrivKey and recipPubKey restricts decryption to the single holder of the recipient's private key.
Encrypted data produced here can only be decrypted with the DECRYPT BLOB command.

overloads.semanticRole: Clears the contents of the specified (or frontmost) window and moves the cursor to its upper-left corner, without removing the window itself from the screen.

constraints: Distinct from CLOSE WINDOW, which removes the window from the screen; ERASE WINDOW only clears its content.

overloads.semanticRole: Evaluates and executes a single line of 4D code built or supplied at runtime (e.g. a user-entered expression), such as a command call, method call, or assignment.

constraints: statement must be a single line of code; control-flow statements (If, While, Return, Break, etc.) are not allowed and are silently ignored if present.
Does nothing if statement is an empty string.
In a compiled database, the statement is executed uninterpreted by the compiler (not compiled), so it is not checked at compile time.
For calling a project method with parameters, prefer EXECUTE METHOD instead.

params.name: subformObject
params.description: Name of subform object

params.name: formula
params.description: Formula object, or name of a project method, to execute in the context of subformObject

params.name: return
params.description: Variable receiving the value returned by formula

params.name: param
params.description: Parameter(s) passed to formula

overloads.semanticRole: Executes formula in the context of subformObject and captures its returned value into 'return'.

params.name: subformObject
params.description: Name of subform object

params.name: formula
params.description: Formula object, or name of a project method, to execute in the context of subformObject
Indicates formula does not return a value

params.name: param
params.description: Parameter(s) passed to formula

overloads.semanticRole: Executes formula in the context of subformObject, explicitly discarding any return value.

constraints: Must be called in the context of the parent form containing subformObject (e.g. from the parent form's form method).
Does nothing if subformObject is not found on the current page or is not yet instantiated.
If the subform belongs to a component, the called method/function must be marked 'Shared by components and host database'.
The execution context is preserved in the called code: the current form and form event remain defined.

params.name: methodName
params.description: Name of project method to be executed

overloads.semanticRole: Executes methodName with no parameters, discarding any result (equivalent to passing '*' with no param list).

params.name: methodName
params.description: Name of project method to be executed

params.name: result
params.description: Variable receiving the method's returned result

params.name: param
params.description: Parameter(s) of the method

overloads.semanticRole: Executes methodName with the given parameters and captures its return value into result.

params.name: methodName
params.description: Name of project method to be executed
Indicates the method does not return a result

params.name: param
params.description: Parameter(s) of the method

overloads.semanticRole: Executes methodName with the given parameters, explicitly discarding any return value.

constraints: The execution context is preserved in the called method: the current form and current form event remain defined.
If methodName belongs to a component being called from the host database (or vice versa), the method must be marked 'Shared by components and host database'.

overloads.semanticRole: Asynchronously queues execution of methodName (with the given parameters) on the named registered 4D Client, running in a process automatically created on that client workstation.

constraints: clientName must be a name previously registered via REGISTER CLIENT.
Pass the wildcard character '@' in clientName to execute the method simultaneously on multiple or all registered 4D Clients.
Repeated calls targeting the same client are queued and executed one after another in asynchronous order (not interrupted or cancelable except by unregistering the client with UNREGISTER CLIENT).

overloads.semanticRole: Expands, in place, a BLOB that was previously compressed with COMPRESS BLOB.

constraints: Sets the OK system variable to 1 if expansion succeeded, 0 otherwise.
If expansion fails due to lack of memory, no error is generated and execution continues (OK is set to 0).
If the BLOB was not previously compressed (via COMPRESS BLOB) or is damaged, error -10600 is generated, trappable with ON ERR CALL.
Use BLOB PROPERTIES to check beforehand whether a BLOB is compressed.

params.name: fileName
params.description: Full path name of the export file, or "" to display the save-file dialog

params.name: project
params.description: in: contents of the export project (XML text, a reference to a pre-existing DOM element, or a BLOB); out: new contents of the export project, only if '*' was also passed
Forces the export dialog box to be displayed (pre-filled with project) and updates project with the resulting parameters

overloads.semanticRole: Exports the current selection's data to fileName, either silently using a supplied export project or interactively via the export dialog box.

constraints: If fileName is an empty string, the standard save-file dialog is displayed and the Document system variable receives the chosen path; if the user cancels, OK is set to 0.
Passing project performs the export directly without user intervention, unless '*' is also passed.
Since 4D v12, export projects are encoded in XML (Text); the legacy BLOB format from pre-v12 databases can still be read but new projects can no longer be saved back to that format.
Sets the OK system variable to 1 if the export succeeded.

overloads.semanticRole: Exports the current selection of aTable (or the default table) to a DIF document, using the current output form to determine which fields/objects are written.

constraints: Export order follows the entry order of fields/objects on the current output form; use an output form containing only what you want exported (buttons and other extraneous objects should not be placed on it; subform objects are ignored).
An On Load event is sent to the output form method for each exported record.
If document is an empty string, the standard save-file dialog is displayed; canceling it sets OK to 0.
Uses the UTF-8 character set by default; since DIF documents typically use IBM437, use USE CHARACTER SET to set the appropriate character set.
Default field delimiter is tab (code 9); default record delimiter is carriage return (code 13); can be changed via the relevant system variables/preferences.
Sets OK to 1 on success, 0 if canceled or an error occurred; the progress thermometer can be hidden with MESSAGES OFF.

params.name: exportedStructure
params.description: Receives the exported 4D database structure definition (XML or HTML, per format)

sentinelValues.meaning: export in XML format (default)
export in HTML format

overloads.semanticRole: Exports the current database's structure definition (tables, fields, indexes, relations, and their attributes) into a Text variable, as XML or HTML.

constraints: Invisible elements are exported (with the corresponding attribute); deleted elements are never exported.
Generates the same output as the Export > Structure definition to XML/HTML file... menu commands.
xml format output is validated against the base_core.dtd/common.dtd files shipped in the DTD folder next to the 4D application; it can be re-imported via IMPORT STRUCTURE.
html format output references an external resources folder (pictures, CSS) that must be reused/created alongside the saved HTML page.

overloads.semanticRole: Exports the current selection of aTable (or the default table) to a SYLK document, using the current output form to determine which fields/objects are written.

constraints: Export order follows the entry order of fields/objects on the current output form; use an output form containing only what you want exported (buttons and other extraneous objects should not be placed on it; subform objects are ignored).
An On Load event is sent to the output form method for each exported record.
If document is an empty string, the standard save-file dialog is displayed; canceling it sets OK to 0.
Uses the UTF-8 character set by default; since SYLK documents typically use ISO-8859-1, use USE CHARACTER SET to set the appropriate character set.
Default field delimiter is tab (code 9); default record delimiter is carriage return, platform-dependent.
Sets OK to 1 on success, 0 if canceled or an error occurred; the progress thermometer can be hidden with MESSAGES OFF.

overloads.semanticRole: Exports the current selection of aTable (or the default table) to a plain text document, using the current output form to determine which fields/objects are written.

constraints: Export order follows the entry order of fields/objects on the current output form; use an output form containing only what you want exported (buttons and other extraneous objects should not be placed on it; subform objects are ignored).
An On Load event is sent to the output form method for each exported record.
If document is an empty string, the standard save-file dialog is displayed; canceling it sets OK to 0.
Uses the UTF-8 character set by default; use USE CHARACTER SET to change it.
Sets OK to 1 on success, 0 if canceled or an error occurred; the progress thermometer can be hidden with MESSAGES OFF.

params.name: blobToEncrypt
params.description: BLOB to encrypt

params.name: keyObject
params.description: JSON object containing the encryption key, with the same structure as the object returned by New data key

params.name: salt
params.description: Additional salt to make the encryption more robust

params.name: encryptedBLOB
params.description: Receives the encrypted data

overloads.semanticRole: Encrypts a BLOB using an explicit encryption-key object (e.g. from New data key).

params.name: blobToEncrypt
params.description: BLOB to encrypt

params.name: passPhrase
params.description: Passphrase used to generate the encryption key directly

params.name: salt
params.description: Additional salt to make the encryption more robust

params.name: encryptedBLOB
params.description: Receives the encrypted data

overloads.semanticRole: Encrypts a BLOB using an encryption key derived directly from a passphrase string.

constraints: Uses the same algorithm 4D uses to encrypt data (AES-256).

The resulting encryptedBLOB length is always a multiple of 16 bytes; if blobToEncrypt is not itself a multiple of 16 bytes, null bytes are appended automatically, so callers working with non-text files must track the original size themselves to correctly decrypt with Decrypt data BLOB.
Returns False and an empty encryptedBLOB on error.

overloads.semanticRole: Encrypts, re-encrypts, or decrypts the data file using passphrase-derived keys (SHA-256) for both the new and, if re-encrypting, current credential.

jointConstraints.rule: For first-time encryption, pass only newPassPhrase and omit curPassPhrase. For re-encrypting an already-encrypted database, pass both (curPassPhrase may instead come from the 4D keychain). To remove encryption entirely, pass an empty string as newPassPhrase while still supplying curPassPhrase.

overloads.semanticRole: Encrypts, re-encrypts, or decrypts the data file using explicit encryption-key objects (from New data key) for both the new and, if re-encrypting, current credential.

jointConstraints.rule: For first-time encryption, pass only newDataKey and omit curDataKey. For re-encrypting an already-encrypted database, pass both (curDataKey may instead come from the 4D keychain). To remove encryption entirely, pass a null data key as newDataKey while still supplying curDataKey.

overloads.semanticRole: Re-encrypts a database that is currently keyed by an explicit data-key object, switching it to a new passphrase-derived key.

jointConstraints.rule: This mixed form re-encrypts a database whose current key is an explicit data-key object (curDataKey), replacing it with a passphrase-derived key (newPassPhrase); both must be supplied together (curDataKey may instead come from the 4D keychain).

constraints: Cannot be used on the currently-open data file.
Can only be executed from 4D in local mode or from 4D Server (as a stored procedure); not available in remote mode.
The dataPath data file must correspond to the structurePath structure file; only tables set as 'encryptable' are affected.
This is a lengthy operation that displays a (user-interruptible) progress indicator and includes a compacting step.

The original files are never modified in place; they are moved into a timestamped backup folder ('Replaced files (Encrypting|Decrypting) YYYY-MM-DD HH-MM-SS'), inside archiveFolder if provided, or next to the structure file otherwise; the command's return value is the path to that backup folder.
A new*/current* passphrase or data key not supplied to the command can instead be supplied via the 4D keychain; the newPassPhrase/newDataKey used is itself never added to the keychain.

methodName, if valid, is called as a progress/status callback taking up to 5 parameters ($messageType, $objectType, $messageText, $table, $reserved) for message/finished/error/end-of-execution/warning events.

overloads.semanticRole: Marks the end of an inline SQL statement sequence started by Begin SQL in the Method editor.

constraints: Must be paired with a preceding Begin SQL: a sequence of SQL statements must be enclosed between Begin SQL and End SQL.

overloads.semanticRole: Tests whether the current record pointer for aTable has moved past the last record of the current selection (e.g. after NEXT RECORD), or the selection is empty.

constraints: PREVIOUS RECORD does not move the pointer back into range once it is past the boundary; use FIRST RECORD, LAST RECORD, or GOTO SELECTED RECORD to do so.
Also returns True in the last footer when a report is printed via PRINT SELECTION or the Print menu, so it can be used to detect the last page's footer.

params.name: picture1
params.description: Original source picture

params.name: picture2
params.description: Picture to compare

params.name: mask
params.description: Receives the resulting comparison mask picture

overloads.semanticRole: Pixel-by-pixel compares the dimensions and contents of two pictures and produces a visual diff mask.

constraints: If dimensions differ, returns False and mask is a blank picture.
If dimensions match but contents differ, returns False and mask is a black-on-white pixel-diff picture (mismatched pixels appear white on black).
If the pictures are identical, returns True and mask is entirely black.
Sets the OK system variable to 0 if a picture is uninitialized (blank), otherwise 1.

overloads.semanticRole: Converts a numeric value between two 'Euroland' currencies (or the Euro itself), routing through the Euro when converting between two non-Euro national currencies.

constraints: Converting between two non-Euro national currencies is calculated via an intermediate conversion through the Euro, per European regulation.
Currency codes must be one of the predefined constants in the 'Euro Currencies' theme (e.g. "EUR", "FRF", "DEM", etc.).

params.name: procedure
params.description: Name of the process method for the new process

sentinelValues.meaning: use the default stack size (recommended)

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the new process; required if param is passed

params.name: param
params.description: Parameter(s) passed to the process method
