If a process named 'name' is already running, reuse it (return its process number) instead of starting a new one

overloads.semanticRole: Starts a new process running 'procedure' on the Server machine (Client/Server) or locally (single-user), optionally reusing an already-running process of the same name.

constraints: Returns a negative process number when called from a 4D Client, a positive one when called on the Server machine; single-user mode behaves like New process.
Returns 0 and generates a trappable error (via ON ERR CALL) if the process could not be created.
If param is passed, the name parameter must also be passed (cannot be omitted).
Pointer expressions cannot be passed as parameters to the process method.
Do not prefix name with '$' to make the process local in Client/Server mode -- unlike New process, this generates an error there (it works only in single-user mode).
If an object or collection is passed as param, a UTF-8 JSON copy is sent (not a reference); any pointers it contains are sent as dereferenced values.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns e (the natural log base, ~2.71828) raised to the power of number; the inverse of Log.
Breaks down the current database structure into text/picture files under folderPath (for source control), optionally filtered by category via options, and returns a status/messages report.

constraints: Only usable from 4D in local mode or 4D Server (errors if called from 4D in remote mode) and only against an interpreted database (does nothing if called from a compiled .4DC database).
When called from a component, always exports the host database's structure, not the component's.
options.filter, if present, switches to an explicit opt-in model: every export category (projectMethods, forms, catalog, etc.) defaults to false and must be individually set to true to be included.
The 'trash' filter only has an effect if 'projectMethods' or 'forms' is also selected.
The returned object's 'success' is false only if any message in 'messages' has severity 'error'.

overloads.semanticRole: Consumes the current event so it is not passed on to 4D's default handling, when called from an ON EVENT CALL event-handling method.

constraints: Must be called from within an event-handling project method installed via ON EVENT CALL.

WARNING: an event-handling method that only calls FILTER EVENT causes 4D to ignore all events for that process (use Ctrl+Shift+Backspace / Cmd-Opt-Shift-Ctrl-Backspace to convert it back to a normal, non-event-receiving process).

Can also be used inside a standard output form method (displayed via DISPLAY SELECTION/MODIFY SELECTION) specifically to filter double-clicks on records, guarded by checking Form event code = On Double Clicked.

overloads.semanticRole: Replaces (or, with an empty string, cancels) the character the user just typed into the currently-edited field/enterable area.

constraints: Must be called from within a form/object method handling the On Before Keystroke form event.

Only the first character of filteredChar is used to replace the entered character; to insert more than one character, shadow the entry into a variable and reassign the enterable area yourself (FILTER KEYSTROKE alone cannot do multi-character replacement).
Passing an empty string cancels/ignores the keystroke entirely.
If Keystroke is called after FILTER KEYSTROKE, it returns the character passed to FILTER KEYSTROKE instead of the actual character typed.

overloads.semanticRole: Loads the first record of aTable's current selection from disk and makes it the current record.

constraints: Query, selection, and sort commands also reset the current record to the first record; FIRST RECORD is a no-op if the selection is empty or the current record is already first.

params.name: size

sentinelValues.meaning: save the cache and free the entire cache memory

params.description: Number of bytes to free from the cache, or '*' to free it entirely; if omitted, the cache is only saved to disk, not freed

overloads.semanticRole: Immediately saves the data buffers to disk and, optionally, frees some or all of the cache memory.

constraints: Passing a parameter to this command is reserved for testing purposes; freeing cache memory in production is not recommended for performance reasons.
By default (no parameter), the cache memory itself is left untouched and continues to be used for subsequent reads; only the data buffers are saved to disk.

params.name: pathname
params.description: Absolute pathname to a volume, directory, or folder

params.name: directories
params.description: Receives the names of the folders located at pathname

overloads.semanticRole: Populates an array with the names of the folders directly located at the given absolute path.

constraints: pathname must be an absolute path; only absolute pathnames are accepted.
Generates a file-manager error (trappable via ON ERR CALL) if pathname is invalid.
If there are no folders at pathname, directories is returned as an empty array.

params.name: fonts
params.description: Filled with the names of scalable font families matching listType

params.name: listType

sentinelValues.meaning: System fonts -- all system fonts (default when omitted)
Favorite fonts -- may be empty if the user has not added any
Recent fonts -- fonts used during the current 4D session

params.description: Type of font list to return, from the 'Font Type List' theme constants

overloads.semanticRole: Populates fonts with font family names filtered by the requested listType category (system, favorite, or recent).

params.name: fonts
params.description: Filled with the names of all system fonts (font families under Windows, or individual font names under macOS if * is passed)
macOS only: return individual scalable font names (e.g. "Arial bold") instead of font family names; has no effect under Windows, which still returns font families.

overloads.semanticRole: Populates fonts with the complete list of system fonts, and on macOS lets the caller request individual font names instead of font family names via the * flag.

constraints: Only scalable fonts are returned; non-scalable/bitmap fonts are never listed.

Under macOS, if the result of this command is used with ST SET ATTRIBUTES on a multi-style text area, the * parameter must not have been passed (only font family names are supported there); 4D Write Pro areas accept either font or font family names.

params.name: fontFamily
params.description: Name of the font family for which to get supported styles and names (see FONT LIST to get the list of font families)

params.name: fontStyleList
params.description: Filled with the localized style names supported by fontFamily

params.name: fontNameList
params.description: Filled with the complete, non-localized font names supported by fontFamily, synchronized element-by-element with fontStyleList

overloads.semanticRole: Returns, for a given font family, the parallel lists of supported (localized) style names and their corresponding (non-localized) complete font names.

constraints: fontStyleList returns localized style names (e.g. "Italic" appears as "Itálico" on a Spanish system), suitable for a localized "Style" pop-up menu.

fontNameList returns non-localized, system-identification-based font names intended for use with the wk font 4D Write Pro attribute of WP SET ATTRIBUTES, so stored documents remain portable across system languages.
If fontFamily is not found on the machine, both arrays are returned empty.

overloads.semanticRole: Converts a classic (binary, structure-file-stored) form into a dynamic form object, applying documented reference/export rules so the result can be run directly via DIALOG.

constraints: References to lists are exported by name instead of a JSON pointer into lists.json; references to named filters/display formats (the '|' prefix) are exported by value instead of a pointer into filters.json.

Pictures from the picture library are not exported: converted objects keep referencing the library via a special "pictlib:xx" icon URL; static pictures are converted as picture-type object properties.
Deprecated objects and unsupported object/properties are ignored during conversion.
For a table form, pass the form's table in aTable and the form name in formName; for a project form, omit aTable and pass the form name directly.
The resulting object is intended to be passed directly to the DIALOG command to run the form.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table owning the form (table form); if omitted, form is a project form

params.name: form
params.description: Name of the form to open in the 4D Form editor

params.name: object
params.description: Name of a form object or group to select automatically; pass an empty string to deselect all objects

sentinelValues.meaning: deselect all objects in the open form

overloads.semanticRole: Opens the specified form (project or table form) in the 4D Form editor, asynchronously, optionally pre-selecting a named object or group (or deselecting all, if object is an empty string).

constraints: Requires access to the Design environment; otherwise error -9804 ("Cannot open form") is generated.
If form does not exist, error 81 ("Form not found") is generated.
The command is asynchronous: it returns immediately without waiting for the editor to actually open.
If object is not found in form, the form still opens and no error is returned.
Passing an empty string in object deselects all objects in the open form.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns an object describing the form event that just occurred, including its numeric code, event name (description), and the triggering object's name (objectName, omitted if the event is triggered by form code).

constraints: Usually called from within a form or object method to inspect the event that just triggered it; returns a null object if there is no current event.
eventObj objects generated for list box/list box column objects, or for 4D View Pro areas (On VP Ready), can carry additional properties beyond code/description/objectName.

overloads.semanticRole: Displays the first page of the current form; does nothing if no form is being displayed/loaded (via FORM LOAD), or if the first page is already showing.

params.name: objectNames
params.description: Filled with the object names sorted by declared entry order; empty if FORM SET ENTRY ORDER was never called for the current form

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Page for which to get the declared entry order; current page if omitted

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the entry order previously declared for the current or given page via FORM SET ENTRY ORDER (empty if never declared).

params.name: objectNames
params.description: Filled with only the valid object names making up the actual, in-effect entry order of the current page
If passed, return the actual entry order currently in effect (default layering order, Form editor order, or a prior FORM SET ENTRY ORDER call) instead of only what was explicitly declared

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the actual, currently effective entry order of the current page, regardless of whether FORM SET ENTRY ORDER was ever called.

constraints: The entry order within a subform is not returned when this command is applied to the parent form.
The actual entry order (the * variant) always includes objects from page 0 and inherited form(s).

params.name: resize
params.description: True if the form can be resized horizontally, False otherwise

params.name: minWidth
params.description: Smallest form width allowed, in pixels

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: Largest form width allowed, in pixels

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the current form's horizontal resizing properties (whether resizable, and the allowed min/max width in pixels).

constraints: These properties may have been set in the Form editor (Design mode) or previously in the current process via FORM SET HORIZONTAL RESIZING.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table for which to return table form names; if omitted, database project form names are returned instead

params.name: arrNames
params.description: Filled with the names of forms matching filter/marker

params.name: filter
params.description: Comparison string limiting returned form names; supports '@' wildcards; empty string or omitted means no filtering

params.name: marker
params.description: In: minimum modification-counter value forms must meet to be returned. Out: overwritten with the new (highest) modification-counter value, for reuse as marker on the next call.
If passed from a component, apply the command to the host database instead of the component (ignored outside of a component context)

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the names of project or table forms in the application, optionally filtered by name pattern and/or by a modification-marker cutoff used for incremental synchronization.

constraints: filter supports the '@' wildcard character for "starts with"/"ends with"/"contains" matching; passing an empty string disables filtering entirely.

marker is a monotonically increasing internal database-resource modification counter: passing a value returns only forms whose marker is >= that value, and if a variable is passed, the command also writes back the new (highest) counter value into it for use as the marker in a subsequent call (incremental version-control sync pattern).

params.name: objectsArray
params.description: Filled with the (unique) names of form objects found; order is not significant

params.name: variablesArray
params.description: Synchronized with objectsArray: filled with pointers to each object's associated variable/field (Is nil pointer if none; a pointer to the subform's table for subform objects)

params.name: pagesArray
params.description: Synchronized with objectsArray: filled with the form page number of each object

params.name: formPageOption
params.default: all pages including inherited objects, if omitted

sentinelValues.meaning: Form current page -- objects of the current page, including page 0, excluding inherited objects
Form all pages -- objects of all pages, excluding inherited objects
Form inherited -- inherited objects only
constants can be combined/summed to select multiple scopes at once

params.description: Bitmask selecting which form part(s) to scan for objects

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the names (and optionally associated variable/field pointers and page numbers) of all non-list-box objects present in the current form, optionally restricted to a scope via formPageOption.

constraints: List box parts are never included; use LISTBOX GET OBJECTS or LISTBOX GET ARRAYS to parse list box contents.
If a passed array was not previously declared, the command creates it and sets its size automatically, but explicit declaration is recommended for compiled applications.
Passing the deprecated * flag is equivalent to formPageOption = Form current page + Form inherited (3); prefer formPageOption instead.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table form only: table of the form, or default table if omitted

params.name: formName
params.description: Name of the form

params.name: width
params.description: Width of the form, in pixels

params.name: height
params.description: Height of the form, in pixels

params.name: numPages
params.description: Number of pages in the form, excluding page 0

params.name: fixedWidth
params.description: True if the form's width is fixed (set), False if resizable/variable

params.name: fixedHeight
params.description: True if the form's height is fixed (set), False if resizable/variable

params.name: title
params.description: Title of the form's window as defined in the Form editor's Property List; empty string if none defined

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the size, page count, resizability, and window title properties of the named form.

constraints: width/height are derived from the form's Default window size property: automatic (sized to fit all objects plus margins), set (manually entered), or based on an object (sized relative to that object's position).
numPages excludes page 0.
title returns an empty string if no window title was defined in the Form editor's Property List.

params.name: resize
params.description: True if the form can be resized vertically, False otherwise

params.name: minHeight
params.description: Smallest form height allowed, in pixels

params.name: maxHeight
params.description: Largest form height allowed, in pixels

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the current form's vertical resizing properties (whether resizable, and the allowed min/max height in pixels).

constraints: These properties may have been set in the Form editor (Design mode) or previously in the current process via FORM SET VERTICAL RESIZING.

overloads.semanticRole: Changes the currently displayed page of the parent form (or, if the trailing * flag is passed, of the current page-type subform) to pageNumber, clamped to the valid page range.

constraints: Does nothing if no form is displayed/loaded (via FORM LOAD), or if pageNumber is already the current page.
pageNumber is clamped: values greater than the number of pages display the last page, and values less than one display the first page.
By default (no *), always applies to the parent form even when called from within a subform's method.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the actual, resolved color scheme ("light" or "dark") of the currently displayed form, or an empty string if there is no current form.

constraints: On Windows with the Classic theme, this command always returns "light".

The color scheme resolution order is: the form's 'Color Scheme' property; if that is 'inherited', SET APPLICATION COLOR SCHEME; if not called or 'inherited', the host database Settings; if 'inherited', the OS user preferences.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the number of the currently displayed page of the parent form (or, if the trailing * flag is passed, of the current page-type subform), or of the form loaded via FORM LOAD.

constraints: The command's own "Description" section text contains a documented 4D doc bug: it says "the command changes the page of the current subform" (copy/pasted from FORM GOTO PAGE), even though this command is a read-only getter (Integer function result). The parameter table's own row ("Returns number of current subform page") and the command name/return type are authoritative; the semanticRole below follows those, not the erroneous prose sentence.

The * parameter is only meaningful when called from within a page-type subform containing several pages: it makes the command report the current subform's own page instead of the parent form's page. When * is omitted, the command always reports the parent form's page.

overloads.semanticRole: Displays the last page of the current form; does nothing if no form is being displayed/loaded (via FORM LOAD), or if the last page is already showing.

Loads a form (by name, .json file path, or description object) as the current form in memory for the current process, optionally attaching formData, so its contents can be printed or parsed without displaying it.

constraints: There can only be one current form per process; loading a new form implicitly replaces the previous current form.
When executed from a component, the command loads the component's own forms by default; passing * makes it load the host database's forms instead.
For printing, a print job must already be open (via OPEN PRINTING JOB) before calling FORM LOAD; OPEN PRINTING JOB implicitly calls FORM UNLOAD first.

formData's properties become available from within the form context via the Form command, and are visible in the On Load form event; alternatively, a user class associated with the form is auto-instantiated to serve the same role.

overloads.semanticRole: Displays the next page of the current form; does nothing if no form is being displayed/loaded (via FORM LOAD), or if the last page is already showing.
Displays the previous page of the current form; does nothing if no form is being displayed/loaded (via FORM LOAD), or if the first page is already showing.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table form only: table of the form (requires formName to also be passed)

params.name: formName
params.description: Name of the form template to screenshot as displayed in the Form editor; if omitted (with aTable), screenshots the form currently being executed/loaded instead

params.name: formPict
params.description: Filled with the screenshot picture

params.name: pageNum
params.description: Page number to screenshot; only meaningful with the form-editor-template syntax (formName passed)

overloads.semanticRole: Returns a picture of a form: either a live screenshot of the form currently being executed/loaded (no formName), or a static screenshot of a named form template as rendered in the Form editor (formName passed, optionally at a specific pageNum).

jointConstraints.rule: aTable is only meaningful when formName is also passed (table-form template lookup); passing aTable alone without formName is not a valid combination.

constraints: The current-form syntax (aTable/formName omitted) only works with input forms and returns the form exactly as executed/loaded, ignoring the containing window's size.
The form-editor-template syntax (formName passed) renders the form as it appears in the Form editor, including inherited forms and page-0 objects, and defaults to page 1 unless pageNum is given.
Web areas are never rendered in the returned screenshot.

Because aTable and formName are both optional, a pointer-returning function call (e.g. Current form table->, Table->) cannot be passed directly as an argument in compiled mode; use an intermediate pointer variable instead.

overloads.semanticRole: Sets, for the current process, the tab/entry order of the current (or specified) form page to the order of valid focusable objects listed in objectNames.

constraints: Only objects with the focusable property are considered valid entry-order candidates (the Tabbable object property is ignored by this command); invalid objects in objectNames are simply skipped at runtime.
A form page includes page 0 objects and inherited form objects.
This command does not set the first focused object at runtime; use GOTO OBJECT in the form's On Load event for that.
For a subform, the entry order must be set by calling this command from within the subform's own context, not from the parent form.

overloads.semanticRole: Sets, for the current process, whether the current form can be resized horizontally and, if so, its minimum/maximum allowed widths in pixels.

jointConstraints.rule: minWidth and maxWidth are only meaningful when resize is True; if resize is False there is no need to pass them (the form's width becomes fixed regardless of any values given).

constraints: New properties apply only to the current process and are not saved with the form; they override (for this process) whatever was set in the Design environment's Form editor.
If minWidth/maxWidth are omitted while resize is True, the values set in the Design environment (if any) are used instead.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table for which to set the input form; default table if omitted

params.name: form
params.description: Name of a table form, a POSIX path to a .json file describing a form, or an object describing a form

params.name: userForm
params.description: Name of a user form (built via _o_CREATE USER FORM) to use as the default input form instead of form

If passed, tells 4D to use the form's Design-environment Form Properties window size settings to automatically resize the window the next time the form is used (as an input form or dialog box); see Open window.

overloads.semanticRole: Designates, for the current process, which form (or user form) is used as the input form of aTable for data entry, import, and related commands.

constraints: form must belong to aTable (or the default table, if aTable is omitted); this command is not compatible with project forms.
Does not display the form; it only designates which form is used for data entry (or by import commands) in the current process, until changed or the process ends.
If the specified form does not exist, the table's default input form (defined in the Explorer) is used instead.
userForm lets a user form (built via _o_CREATE USER FORM) be designated instead of the plain input form, so several custom user forms can coexist and be switched between.

overloads.semanticRole: Designates, for the current process, which form (or user form) is used as the output form of aTable for list display, reporting, and export commands.

constraints: form must belong to aTable (or the default table, if aTable is omitted); this command is not compatible with project forms.
Does not display the form; it only designates which form is printed, displayed as a list, or exported in the current process, until changed or the process ends.
If the specified form does not exist, the table's default output form (defined in the Explorer) is used instead.
Used by three groups of commands: list display (DISPLAY SELECTION, MODIFY SELECTION), reporting (PRINT LABEL, PRINT SELECTION), and export (EXPORT DIF, EXPORT SYLK, EXPORT TEXT).
userForm lets a user form (built via _o_CREATE USER FORM) be designated instead of the plain output form, so several custom user forms can coexist and be switched between.

overloads.semanticRole: Sets the current form's size by programming, in one of three modes selected by which optional parameters are passed: automatic sizing with margins (object omitted, * passed), sizing relative to an object plus margins (object passed, * omitted), or a fixed width/height (both omitted).

jointConstraints.rule: object and * are mutually exclusive (cannot both be passed). With * passed (object omitted): horizontal/vertical are the right/bottom margins (px) added around all form objects for automatic sizing. With object passed (* omitted, and * cannot be passed in this mode): horizontal/vertical are the right/bottom margins (px) added around that object. With both omitted: horizontal/vertical are the fixed width/height (px) of the form.

constraints: The new size applies to the current process only and is not saved with the form.
This command takes horizontal/vertical resizing properties into account: e.g. if the minimum width is 500px and the command sets 400px, the actual resulting width is clamped to 500px.
Does not change the form window's size (only the form itself); use RESIZE FORM WINDOW for the window.

overloads.semanticRole: Sets, for the current process, whether the current form can be resized vertically and, if so, its minimum/maximum allowed heights in pixels.

jointConstraints.rule: minHeight and maxHeight are only meaningful when resize is True; if resize is False there is no need to pass them (the form's height becomes fixed regardless of any values given).

constraints: New properties apply only to the current process and are not saved with the form; they override (for this process) whatever was set in the Design environment's Form editor.
If minHeight/maxHeight are omitted while resize is True, the values set in the Design environment (if any) are used instead.

overloads.semanticRole: Releases from memory the current form previously loaded via FORM LOAD.

constraints: Only necessary when FORM LOAD was used outside of a printing context; when printing, the current form is automatically closed again when CLOSE PRINTING JOB is called.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the OS interface rendering theme actually used by the current form ("Classic"/"FluentUI" on Windows, "Classic"/"LiquidGlass" on macOS), or an empty string if there is no current form.

constraints: On Windows, the rendering theme can be set at application and/or form level (inherited or explicit) and also depends on the availability of specific Microsoft libraries at runtime.

On macOS 26 Tahoe and later (as of 4D/4D Server 21 R3), the Liquid Glass interface is used automatically and cannot be disabled, except transitionally in engine-based applications via Apple's UIDesignRequiresCompatibility Info.plist key.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the Boolean literal False (useful in typed expressions/contexts where a literal Boolean function call is required rather than a bare keyword).
Returns the name of the field pointed to by fieldPtr.

discriminatedBy.rule: single Pointer argument selects the pointer-based syntax

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the name of the field identified by its table number and field number.

discriminatedBy.rule: two Integer arguments select the table-number/field-number syntax

overloads.semanticRole: Returns a pointer to the field designated by its table number and field number.

discriminatedBy.rule: Two Integer parameters (tableNum, fieldNum) -- forward lookup from numeric identifiers to a field pointer.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the field number of the field designated by a field pointer.

discriminatedBy.rule: A single Pointer parameter (fieldPtr) -- reverse lookup from a field pointer to its numeric field number.

overloads.semanticRole: Creates and returns a 4D.File object for the file at the given path string.

discriminatedBy.rule: first argument is a Text path string

overloads.semanticRole: Creates and returns a 4D.File object for a 4D built-in or system file designated by a file constant; returns a null object if the designated file does not currently exist.

discriminatedBy.rule: first argument is an Integer file constant

constraints: Only absolute pathnames are supported; the command does not accept relative paths.
By default the path is interpreted as POSIX syntax; a platform-specific pathname (Windows or macOS) must be flagged via the pathType parameter (fk platform path).

The optional trailing * parameter is only meaningful when the command is called from a component: it makes the command resolve against the host database instead of the component. If * is omitted when called from a component, a null object is always returned.

overloads.semanticRole: The Find in array command returns the number of the first element in array that matches value .

constraints: The array and value parameters must be of the same type (Text, Numeric, Date, Pointer, Object, or Boolean arrays are supported); with Object arrays only object references can be used for value, not deep equality.
Matching uses the same equality rules as the equality operator (exact match), not a substring/wildcard search.

params.name: targetField
params.description: Field on which to execute the search

params.name: value
params.description: in: value to search for (may use the '@' wildcard); out: value found

overloads.semanticRole: Searches for the first record whose targetField equals value (supports the '@' wildcard), returning its record number, or -1 if none is found; on success, value is overwritten with the value found.

constraints: Because value is reassigned by the search (it is both an input search value and an output for the value found), you cannot pass a numbered parameter ($1, $2, etc.) as value -- this would cause malfunctions in compiled mode.
If value is itself a field, its value is reassigned when the query succeeds, so Modified record will return True for the current record afterward.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If passed, list below is an object name (string) representing the list in the form; if omitted, list is a hierarchical list reference number (ListRef).

params.name: list
params.description: List reference number (if leading * omitted) or name of the list-type form object (if leading * passed).

params.name: value
params.description: Character string to search for (supports '@' wildcard).

sentinelValues.meaning: limit the search to the first (main) level of the list
extend the search to all sublists

params.name: itemsArray
params.description: Filled by the command with the positions (if trailing * omitted) or reference numbers (if trailing * passed) of every matching item; created/resized automatically.

params.name: asReference
params.description: If passed, work with absolute reference numbers of items; if omitted, work with current item positions.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the position or reference number of the first list item matching value (0 if none found), optionally filling itemsArray with every match.

constraints: If only a single representation of the list is used, or item reference numbers are worked with (the second * omitted), either syntax may be used; if several representations of the same list exist and item positions are used, the object-name syntax (leading *) is required since positions vary per representation.
Matching is exact ('is exactly'); use the '@' wildcard in value for begins-with/ends-with/contains searches.

params.name: array
params.description: Array to search

params.name: value
params.description: Value (same type as array) to search for

params.name: order
params.description: '>' if array is sorted ascending, '<' if descending

params.name: posFirst

constraints: On Windows, the returned configuration depends on context: inside a form, it reflects the interface (Fluent UI or Classic) actually used by that form; outside a form, it reflects the interface enabled for the project.
In project architecture, only the three automatic style sheets (__automatic__, __automatic_additional_text__, __automatic_main_text__) are supported.
The OK system variable is set to 0 if styleSheetName does not exist (1 otherwise).

format must be one of the System Format theme constants (e.g. Currency symbol, Decimal separator, Date/Time separators, short/medium/long date and time patterns, day/month/year position in short dates, AM/PM labels, Thousand separator); the returned value is always a string, formatted according to the operating system's regional settings.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the properties of the table designated by a pointer.

discriminatedBy.rule: Use this overload when you have a pointer to the table rather than its table number.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the properties of the table designated by its table number.

discriminatedBy.rule: Use this overload when you have the table number rather than a pointer to the table.

constraints: trigLoadRec is obsolete and should not be used.

overloads.semanticRole: The GET TABLE TITLES command fills the tableTitles and tableNums arrays with the names and numbers of database tables defined in the Structure window or using the SET TABLE TITLES command.

constraints: Does not return invisible tables.
If SET TABLE TITLES was called during the session, returns only the modified names/numbers it set, rather than all database tables defined in the Structure window.

overloads.semanticRole: The GET TEXT KEYWORDS command splits all the text into individual words and creates an item in the arrKeywords text array for each word.

constraints: If the optional * parameter is passed, each distinct word is stored only once in arrKeywords; otherwise every occurrence is stored, even duplicates.

overloads.semanticRole: GET USER LIST populates the arrays userNames and userNumbers with the names and unique ID numbers of the users as they appear in the Passwords window.

constraints: userNames includes users whose accounts are disabled (shown in green in the Passwords window).

overloads.semanticRole: GET USER PROPERTIES returns the information about the user whose unique user ID number you pass in userID .

constraints: userID must be a valid user ID number returned by GET USER LIST; otherwise error -9979 is generated (catchable via ON ERR CALL), or check first with Is user deleted.
password is obsolete and always returns an empty string; use the Validate password function to check a user's password.
nbLogin, lastLogin, and groupOwner are meaningful for binary databases only; they always return 0 (0 / 00/00/00 for lastLogin) in project databases.

sentinelValues.meaning: Windows only: returns the coordinates of the MDI application window (contents area) instead of a specific window.

overloads.semanticRole: The GET WINDOW RECT command returns the coordinates of the window whose reference number is passed in window .

constraints: If window does not exist, the four out parameters are left unchanged.
If window is omitted, applies to the frontmost window of the current process.

overloads.semanticRole: Selects the form object identified by name (a string) as the active data entry area.

discriminatedBy.rule: When * is passed, object is interpreted as an object name (Text) rather than a direct field/variable reference.

overloads.semanticRole: Selects the given field or variable object directly (by reference) as the active data entry area.

discriminatedBy.rule: When * is omitted, object must be a direct Field or Variable reference rather than a name string.

constraints: Passing an empty object name (with * specified) removes focus from any object in the current form.
When called from a subform, first searches for the object within the subform, then extends the search to the parent form's objects if not found there.

overloads.semanticRole: GOTO RECORD selects the specified record of aTable as the current record.

constraints: If record is less than the smallest or greater than the greatest record number in the database, 4D generates an out-of-range error.
If record is the number of a deleted record, 4D generates error -10503 and the selection becomes empty.

sentinelValues.meaning: Deselects the current record: no record becomes current in aTable (useful for single-selection mode/subforms).

overloads.semanticRole: GOTO SELECTED RECORD moves to the specified record in the current selection of aTable and makes that record the current record.

constraints: Does nothing if the current selection is empty, if record is not in the current selection, or if record is already the current record.

overloads.semanticRole: The GOTO XY command is used in conjunction with the MESSAGE command when you display messages in a window opened using Open window .

constraints: The character cursor resets to position 0,0 when a window is opened, and after ERASE WINDOW is executed.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns a new random UUID using the default version (v4).

sentinelValues.meaning: Default if omitted: fully random UUID.
Random and timestamp UUID; chronological order matches lexical order.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns a new UUID generated using the explicitly specified version.

sentinelValues.meaning: MD5 digest (128 bits, 32 hex characters).
SHA1 digest (160 bits, 40 hex characters).
Obsolete: 4D REST digest constant.
SHA-256 digest (256 bits, 64 hex characters).
SHA-512 digest (512 bits, 128 hex characters).

overloads.semanticRole: The Generate digest command returns the digest key of a BLOB or text after application of an encryption algorithm.

constraints: Not recommended for handling passwords; use Generate password hash / Verify password hash instead of MD5/SHA algorithms for that purpose.
Calling the command on an empty text/BLOB does not return an empty string; it returns the algorithm's actual digest of an empty input (e.g. "d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e" for MD5).
The returned digest value is identical across platforms (macOS/Windows) since the calculation is based on the UTF-8 representation of the input.

overloads.semanticRole: The Generate password hash function returns a secure password hash generated by a cryptographic hash algorithm.

constraints: Only the first 72 characters of password are used.
options.algorithm defaults to "bcrypt" (currently the only supported value; error 850 if unsupported).
options.cost defaults to 10 and must be between 4 and 31 for bcrypt (error 852 if out of range).
If either option value is invalid, the command generates an error and returns an empty string.
Multiple hash calls on the same password produce different hashed strings (bcrypt salts each call).

overloads.semanticRole: The Get 4D file command returns the pathname to the 4D environment file specified by the file parameter.

constraints: If the target file does not exist, an empty path is returned; no error is raised.

When called from a component, pass * to get the host database's file path instead of the component's; for User settings file and User settings file for data, omitting * from a component context always returns an empty string.
For User settings file / User settings file for data, a path is only returned if 'Enable User Settings in External File' is checked in the Database Settings dialog box.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get 4D folder command returns the pathname to the active 4D folder of the current application, or to the 4D environment folder specified by the folder and options parameters, if passed.

constraints: If folder is omitted, returns the pathname of the active 4D folder of the current application.
options is only taken into account when folder designates the '4D Client database folder' constant; it is ignored otherwise.

The optional * parameter only has an effect, when called from a component, for the 'Database folder', 'Database folder Unix syntax', and 'Current resources folder' constants (returning the host database's folder instead of the component's); it is ignored for all other folder values and when called from the host database.
When called from a remote 4D, the path returned is that of the remote machine, not of 4D Server.
Executing this command with the 'Current resources folder' or 'Logs folder' constant creates that folder if it does not already exist.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get Application color scheme command returns the name of the actual color scheme in use at the application level.

constraints: On Windows, this command always returns "light", regardless of settings.
The optional * parameter only matters when called from a component: it returns the color scheme of the host database instead of the component's own scheme.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get adjusted blobs cache priority command returns the current adjusted cache priority value applied in cache by the cache manager for the aTable "blobs" data.

constraints: Only works in local mode (4D Server and 4D); cannot be used in 4D remote mode.
Intended for debugging purposes only.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get adjusted index cache priority command returns the current adjusted cache priority value applied by the cache manager for the aField index(es).

constraints: Only works in local mode (4D Server and 4D); cannot be used in 4D remote mode.
Intended for debugging purposes only.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get adjusted table cache priority command returns the adjusted cache priority value applied in cache by the cache manager for the aTable scalar data.

constraints: Only works in local mode (4D Server and 4D); cannot be used in 4D remote mode.
Intended for debugging purposes only.
Applies to scalar data fields (date/hour, numeric, or string type).

overloads.semanticRole: The Get assert enabled command returns True or False according to whether or not assertions are enabled in the current process.
The Get cache size command returns the current database cache size in bytes.This command only works in local mode (4D Server and 4D); it must not be used from 4D in remote mode.

constraints: Local mode only (4D Server and 4D); must not be used from 4D in remote mode.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get current printer command returns the name of the current printer defined in the 4D application.

constraints: Returns "_4d_pdf_printer" (or the actual PDF driver name) when the Generic PDF driver constant was set via SET CURRENT PRINTER.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the database's default language, the language specified by languageType, or (with the standalone '*' syntax) the host database's language when called from a component.

constraints: The optional * parameter is only useful when the command is called from a component: if passed, returns the language configuration of the host database; if omitted, returns the component database's own language configuration.
When called from a method of the host database, always returns the host database's language configuration regardless of *.
If languageType is omitted, returns the current/default language (Current localization, value 1).

overloads.semanticRole: The Get database parameter command allows you to get the current value of a 4D database parameter.

discriminatedBy.rule: The returned numeric value / stringValue's meaning and possible values are selected by which DatabaseParameterSelector constant is passed; some selectors are get-only.

constraints: aTable is optional; if omitted, the parameter is retrieved/set for the default table.
When the selector's value is a character string, it is returned via stringValue instead of (or in addition to) the numeric function result.

selector's accepted value(s) depend on which DatabaseParameterSelector constant is passed; several selectors (Direct2D status, Diagnostic log level, Min TLS version, Times inside objects, Dates inside objects) draw their own value from a dedicated sub-enum -- see each DatabaseParameterSelector entry's description.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get default user command returns the unique user ID of the user set as “Default user” in the database Settings dialog box: If no default user has been set, the command returns 0.

constraints: Returns 0 if no default user has been set in the database Settings dialog box.

constraints: Operates only on a document that is currently open, referenced by docRef (obtained from a prior open/create document call); the returned position is relative to the beginning of the document and reflects where the next RECEIVE PACKET (read) or SEND PACKET (write) will occur.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get document size command returns the size, expressed in bytes, of a document.

constraints: document may be either an open document's reference number, or the name/pathname of a document that is not open.
The optional * parameter only affects the result on Macintosh: if omitted, returns the size of the document's data fork; if passed, returns the size of the resource fork.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get edited text command is mainly to be used with the On After Edit form event to retrieve the text as it is being entered.

constraints: Behavior depends on the calling form event: during On Before Keystroke returns the text as it was before the last keystroke; during On After Keystroke or On After Edit returns the text including the last character entered.
Returns an empty string when used outside of a text-entry form-object context.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get external data path command returns the full pathname of the external storage file for the data of the field passed in the aField parameter, for the current record.

constraints: Returns an empty string if the field's data is not stored externally, if the field has a Null value, or when called from a remote 4D.
The returned pathname is given even if the target file does not exist or is not accessible.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get file from pasteboard command returns the absolute pathname of a file included in a drag and drop operation.

constraints: Returns an empty string if there is no Xth file in the pasteboard.

If resFile is omitted, the first matching resource found in the resource files chain (or across all open XLIFF files) is returned; if resFile is passed, only that file is searched.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get picture file name command returns the current default name of the picture passed as parameter.
The Get plugin access command returns the name of the user group authorized to use the plug-in whose number was passed in the plugIn parameter.

constraints: plugIn is one of the 'Is License Available' theme plug-in constants (e.g. 4D Client SOAP license = 808465465, 4D Client Web license = 808465209, 4D for OCI license = 808465208, 4D ODBC Pro license = 808464946, 4D View license = 808465207, 4D Write license = 808464697) or a raw plug-in number.
Returns an empty string if no user group is associated with the plug-in.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get pointer command returns a pointer to the process or interprocess variable whose name you pass in varName .

constraints: varName may include array element subscripts (e.g. "ArrName+\"{3}\"" or, for 2D arrays, "ArrName+\"{3}{5}\""), but variable-subscript expressions such as "ArrName+\"{myVar}\"" are not supported.
Use Field to get a pointer to a field, and Table to get a pointer to a table, instead of Get pointer.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get print marker command enables you to get the current position of a marker during printing.

constraints: markNum must be one of the 'Form Area' theme constants (e.g. Form header, Form detail, Form footer, Form break0..Form break9, etc.); the returned position is in pixels (1 pixel = 1/72 inch).
Only meaningful when called during the On Header form event (in the context of PRINT SELECTION / PRINT RECORD) or the On Printing Detail form event (in the context of Print form).

overloads.semanticRole: The Get print preview command returns True if the SET PRINT PREVIEW command was called with the True value in the current process.

constraints: Reflects only the SET PRINT PREVIEW setting for the current process, which the user can still override in the print dialog before validating it; use Is in print preview to get the final, actual printing mode.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get printed height command returns the overall height (in pixels) of the section printed using the Print form command.

constraints: Returned height is in pixels, between 0 (top edge of the page) and the overall printable-area height returned by GET PRINTABLE AREA; if a new Print form section doesn't fit in the remaining printable area, a new page is generated and 0 is returned.
Only the top and bottom printable margins (settable via SET PRINTABLE MARGIN) affect the value returned; the left/right margins do not.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get query limit command returns the limit for the number of records that a query may find in the current process.

constraints: Reflects the limit set by SET QUERY LIMIT for the current process; defaults to 0 (unlimited) if no limit has been set.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get resource name command returns the name of the resource whose type is passed in resType and whose ID number is passed in resID .

constraints: resType must be a 4-character resource type string.
If resFile is omitted, the resource is searched for across all currently open resource files; if passed, only that file is searched.
Returns an empty string if the resource does not exist.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get resource properties command returns the attributes of the resource whose type is passed in resType and whose ID number is passed in resID .

constraints: resType must be a 4-character resource type string.
If resFile is omitted, the resource is searched for across all currently open resource files; if passed, only that file is searched.
Returns 0 and sets the OK system variable to 0 if the resource does not exist.
The returned integer is a bit-field value: individual bits carry distinct meaning (see the resource attributes documentation) rather than a single scalar.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get selected menu item parameter command returns the custom character string associated with the selected menu item.

constraints: Applies to the currently selected menu item; must have been set beforehand via SET MENU ITEM PARAMETER, otherwise returns an empty string.
Returns an empty string if no menu item is currently selected.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get string resource command returns the string stored in the string (“STR ”) resource whose ID is passed in resID .

constraints: If resFile is omitted, the first matching STR resource found in the resource files chain is returned; if passed, only that file is searched.
Returns an empty string and sets the OK system variable to 0 if the resource is not found.
A STR resource is limited to 255 characters.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get subrecord key command facilitates the migration of 4D code using converted subtables to standard code for working with tables.Beginning with version 11 of 4D, subtables are not supported.

constraints: idField must be a field of the special 'Subtable Relation' type (or a converted 'Longint' field) created when 4D migrated a pre-v11 subtable into an automatic relation between two standard tables; intended only to support migrating that legacy code to standard relation-based code, not for new automatic relations.

overloads.semanticRole: Get text from pasteboard returns the text present in the pasteboard.

constraints: The pasteboard is equivalent to the system Clipboard for copy/paste operations; enriched text (e.g. RTF) keeps its attributes only if the destination area is compatible with that format.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get text resource command returns the text stored in the text (“TEXT”) resource whose ID is passed in resID .

constraints: If resFile is omitted, the first matching TEXT resource found in the resource files chain is returned; if passed, only that file is searched.
Returns empty text and sets the OK system variable to 0 if the resource is not found.
A TEXT resource is limited to 32,000 characters.

overloads.semanticRole: The Get window title command returns the title of the window whose reference number is passed in window .

constraints: If window is omitted, returns the title of the frontmost window of the current process.
Returns an empty string if the designated window does not exist.

overloads.semanticRole: The HIDE MENU BAR command makes the menu bar invisible.

constraints: No-op if the menu bar is already hidden.

overloads.semanticRole: HIDE PROCESS hides all windows that belong to process .

constraints: Hides all windows and the menu bar belonging to process; the process keeps executing while hidden, and is only made visible again by SHOW PROCESS. No-op if the process is already hidden.
The Debugger window is a special exception: if it needs to display while process is hidden, process is shown and becomes frontmost.
The Main Process and Cache Manager processes cannot be hidden with this command.
To keep a process's UI hidden from the moment it's created, call HIDE PROCESS as the first statement of the process method.

overloads.semanticRole: The HIDE TOOL BAR command handles the display of custom toolbars created by the Open form window command for the current process.

constraints: Only affects a toolbar window previously created by Open form window with the Toolbar form window option, for the current process; no-op if the toolbar was already hidden or none has been created.

overloads.semanticRole: The HIDE WINDOW command hides the window whose number was passed in window or, if this parameter is omitted, the current process frontmost window.

params.description: Name of the set of records to highlight; the UserSet set if omitted.
If passed, disables the automatic scroll of the list to reveal highlighted records.

overloads.semanticRole: Highlights (visually selects) the records of a set (or the UserSet if setName is omitted) in a list form, without changing the current selection.

constraints: For an included subform, this command only has an effect if the subform's Selection Mode property is set to Multiple; otherwise use GOTO SELECTED RECORD to highlight a single line.

overloads.semanticRole: Highlights a section of text in the named form object, identified by its object name (string), because the leading * marker is passed.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when object should be interpreted as an object name (string) identifying a form object, rather than a direct field/variable reference.

overloads.semanticRole: Highlights a section of text in the given form field or variable, passed directly by reference (no leading * marker).

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the leading * is omitted and object is passed as a direct field or variable reference instead of an object name.

constraints: If startSel equals endSel, no text is highlighted and the insertion point is simply placed before the character at that position.
If endSel is greater than the number of characters in object, all characters from startSel through the end of the text are highlighted.

params.description: Authentication method to use: HTTP basic (1) or HTTP digest (2).
